verdict.rationale: Cline documents multiple programmatic surfaces — a headless CLI for scripting/CI (cline-docs-2,3,4), ACP support so external clients can drive Cline as an agent (cline-docs-7), cron scheduling via a hub (cline-docs-13), and a claim that 'the same core engine' can power custom-built agents/integrations (cline-docs-19) — which together function as an AI-native automation interface. However, no formal public REST/SDK API with schema was found; an explicit OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths (cline-probe-3), so there's no traditional documented API contract. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/SDK reference, and independent hands-on confirmation that third-party integrations actually consume this 'core engine' API.
